ctx.x: How long was Melton on the band?

The violin player? The violin player, yeah. The violin player was Charlie Hershoff from Dora, Illinois. And the drummer was, the name was Little. The first name I don't know. That was the three, that was the combination of piano, violin and drums. That was the first combination. And later on, of course, went to the larger orchestras. How long was Melton on the band?
